summary_md:
**Aleksandar Perisic ([@apsolut](https://x.com/apsolut/status/2115181931788935556))** open-sources **one-shot-multicam**: a single phone selfie stays as camera A, while open-weight models on ComfyUI generate lip-synced B and C angles from his real voice and then auto-cut the edit. The GitHub repo describes it as ComfyUI plus an LTX-2.3 ID LoRA, all open weights.

- **Follow-up (thread):** he added a live, no-setup demo at multicam.apsolut.dev. You upload a talking selfie clip of up to 30 s; it picks cut points and generates the other angles on ComfyUI Cloud. Free runs are limited, but you can paste your own Comfy key for more.

Multicam: one phone shot in. A whole camera crew out.

relevance: A fully local, open-weight agentic video pipeline that turns one shot into a multicam edit.
